summary.en: Explicit ellipsoids with constant RGB or a direction-dependent color function.
summary.zh: 显式椭球，搭配固定 RGB 或随观察方向变化的颜色函数。

parameters.en: Center μ; scales s; rotation q; opacity; RGB or per-channel SH coefficients.
parameters.zh: 中心 μ、尺度 s、旋转 q、透明度，以及 RGB 或各通道 SH 系数。

learn.en: Optimize geometry, opacity and color coefficients from calibrated images.
learn.zh: 用标定图像优化几何、透明度和颜色系数。

exported.en: Explicit splats. A chosen container may quantize parameters and reduce SH degree.
exported.zh: 显式 splat 参数；所选容器可能量化参数或降低 SH 阶数。

runtime.en: Decode → cull / project → evaluate RGB or SH → sort → rasterize and composite.
runtime.zh: 解码 → 剔除／投影 → RGB 或 SH 求值 → 排序 → 光栅化与合成。

contract.en: PLY is a container: inspect its fields, SH order, scale/opacity activations and quaternion order. Point-cloud PLY and STG PLY are not interchangeable with static 3DGS.
contract.zh: PLY 是容器：需检查字段、SH 顺序、尺度／透明度激活和四元数顺序。点云 PLY、STG PLY 与静态 3DGS 不能混用。

asset.en: The appearance workbench below links a trained SH model. Spark and PlayCanvas support standard 3DGS in their documented formats.
asset.zh: 下方外观工作台提供训练好的 SH 模型入口。Spark 与 PlayCanvas 支持其文档中列出的标准 3DGS 格式。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

geometry.zh: 三维空间中的二维椭圆盘

summary.en: Surface elements with two in-plane scales and a normal. The scene is still three-dimensional.
summary.zh: 用面内两轴尺度和法线描述表面元素；整个场景仍然是三维的。

parameters.en: 3D center; orientation / tangent frame; two scales; opacity; appearance.
parameters.zh: 三维中心、朝向／切线坐标架、两个尺度、透明度和外观。

learn.en: Optimize surfels with image supervision and surface-oriented regularization.
learn.zh: 通过图像监督和面向表面的正则项优化面元。

exported.en: Surfel parameters in the implementation’s schema. A mesh extracted afterward is a different asset.
exported.zh: 按实现约定导出的面元参数。后续提取的 mesh 是另一种资产。

runtime.en: Perspective-correct ray–surfel evaluation → Gaussian weight → ordered compositing.
runtime.zh: 透视正确的射线／面元求值 → Gaussian 权重 → 有序合成。

contract.en: Use the 2D rendering mode. Adding a tiny third scale and using ordinary 3D projection is an approximation, not the reference 2DGS renderer.
contract.zh: 使用二维面元渲染模式。补一个很小的第三轴尺度再做普通 3D 投影只是近似，并非参考 2DGS 渲染器。

asset.en: Official code links SIBR and GaussianSplats3D. The web viewer has a “2D scene” file option; bring a matching trained 2DGS file. A public bundled checkpoint has not been verified here.
asset.zh: 官方列出了 SIBR 与 GaussianSplats3D。网页 viewer 的文件选项有“2D scene”，需要匹配的训练文件；此处尚未验证可直接下载的配套 checkpoint。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

asset.en: Author gallery lists SH, SV, NASG, NASGabor and Neural checkpoints for matching scenes. Use a separately trained file for each mode.
asset.zh: 作者图库列出了同一批场景的 SH、SV、NASG、NASGabor 和 Neural checkpoint。每种模式使用各自训练的文件。

contract.en: Keep the trained direction convention, base/residual activations and output range. A .ngsplat file needs this renderer; a generic PLY loader cannot decode it.
contract.zh: 保留训练时的方向约定、基础色／残差激活和输出范围。.ngsplat 需要对应渲染器，普通 PLY loader 无法解码。

summary.en: Learned directional color sites, blended smoothly for the current view.
summary.zh: 学习一组方向与颜色站点，按当前视角平滑混合。

parameters.en: Per-splat unit direction sites, temperatures and RGB values, plus base color.
parameters.zh: 每点的单位方向站点、温度参数、RGB 数值与基础色。

learn.en: Learn the sites, their sharpness and colors together with the splats.
learn.zh: 与 splat 一起学习方向站点、过渡锐度和颜色。

exported.en: Normalized sites, activated temperatures / colors, stored in .ngsplat.
exported.zh: 归一化站点及激活后的温度／颜色，存入 .ngsplat。

runtime.en: Direction → site distances → stable softmax → RGB → splatting.
runtime.zh: 方向 → 站点距离 → 稳定 softmax → RGB → splatting。

models.equation: w_j={e^{-\tau_j\|\mathbf s_j-\mathbf d\|}\over\sum_k e^{-\tau_k\|\mathbf s_k-\mathbf d\|}},\quad\mathbf r=\sum_j w_j\mathbf c_j

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

asset.en: Author gallery lists SH, SV, NASG, NASGabor and Neural checkpoints for matching scenes. Use a separately trained file for each mode.
asset.zh: 作者图库列出了同一批场景的 SH、SV、NASG、NASGabor 和 Neural checkpoint。每种模式使用各自训练的文件。

contract.en: Keep the trained direction convention, base/residual activations and output range. A .ngsplat file needs this renderer; a generic PLY loader cannot decode it.
contract.zh: 保留训练时的方向约定、基础色／残差激活和输出范围。.ngsplat 需要对应渲染器，普通 PLY loader 无法解码。

summary.en: Learned anisotropic lobes concentrate appearance changes in chosen directions.
summary.zh: 可学习的各向异性波瓣把外观变化集中在特定方向。

appearance.zh: 归一化各向异性球面 Gaussian

parameters.en: Lobe coordinate frames, concentration, anisotropy and RGB weights.
parameters.zh: 波瓣坐标架、集中程度、各向异性参数与 RGB 权重。

learn.en: Optimize lobe shape, orientation and contribution to each channel.
learn.zh: 优化波瓣形状、朝向及其在各通道中的贡献。

exported.en: Precomputed frames, activated shape parameters, normalization and weights.
exported.zh: 预计算坐标架、激活后的形状参数、归一化常量与权重。

runtime.en: Evaluate each lobe using dot products, pow and exp; combine to RGB before splatting.
runtime.zh: 用点积、pow 和 exp 对每个波瓣求值，先合成 RGB 再 splatting。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

asset.en: Author gallery lists SH, SV, NASG, NASGabor and Neural checkpoints for matching scenes. Use a separately trained file for each mode.
asset.zh: 作者图库列出了同一批场景的 SH、SV、NASG、NASGabor 和 Neural checkpoint。每种模式使用各自训练的文件。

contract.en: Keep the trained direction convention, base/residual activations and output range. A .ngsplat file needs this renderer; a generic PLY loader cannot decode it.
contract.zh: 保留训练时的方向约定、基础色／残差激活和输出范围。.ngsplat 需要对应渲染器，普通 PLY loader 无法解码。

summary.en: Adds an angular oscillation to a lobe to represent finer directional variation.
summary.zh: 在波瓣中加入角度振荡，表达更细的方向变化。

parameters.en: NASG parameters plus a learned oscillation frequency per lobe.
parameters.zh: NASG 参数，以及每个波瓣学习到的振荡频率。

learn.en: Jointly fit the lobe parameters and oscillation frequency.
learn.zh: 联合拟合波瓣参数与振荡频率。

exported.en: Baked lobe frames and constants, frequency and RGB weights.
exported.zh: 烘焙的波瓣坐标架与常量、频率及 RGB 权重。

runtime.en: Directional lobe response × cosine modulation → weighted RGB → splatting.
runtime.zh: 方向波瓣响应 × 余弦调制 → 加权 RGB → splatting。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

asset.en: Author gallery lists SH, SV, NASG, NASGabor and Neural checkpoints for matching scenes. Use a separately trained file for each mode.
asset.zh: 作者图库列出了同一批场景的 SH、SV、NASG、NASGabor 和 Neural checkpoint。每种模式使用各自训练的文件。

contract.en: Keep the trained direction convention, base/residual activations and output range. A .ngsplat file needs this renderer; a generic PLY loader cannot decode it.
contract.zh: 保留训练时的方向约定、基础色／残差激活和输出范围。.ngsplat 需要对应渲染器，普通 PLY loader 无法解码。

title.zh: 神经外观 · 逐点解码

summary.en: A compact feature per Gaussian and a small decoder shared by the whole scene.
summary.zh: 每个 Gaussian 保存紧凑特征，整个场景共享一个小解码器。

appearance.zh: 特征 + 共享残差 MLP

parameters.en: Per-splat features / base color; shared weights; encoding and activation metadata.
parameters.zh: 每点特征／基础色，共享权重，编码和激活元数据。

learn.en: Optimize features and shared MLP weights with the Gaussian parameters.
learn.zh: 与 Gaussian 参数一起优化特征和共享 MLP 权重。

exported.en: Features or baked first-layer static terms, plus remaining network weights.
exported.zh: 特征或第一层烘焙后的静态项，以及其余网络权重。

runtime.en: Per-splat feature + view encoding → tiny MLP → cached RGB → splatting.
runtime.zh: 逐点特征 + 方向编码 → 小 MLP → RGB 缓存 → splatting。

time.zh: 多项式运动 + 时间透明度

summary.en: A compact moving scene, evaluated directly from time. This is our working Rust/wgpu fixture.
summary.zh: 直接输入时间求值的紧凑动态场景；这是本站已运行的 Rust/wgpu 真实模型。

parameters.en: Center, scales, quaternion, RGB, opacity; temporal center / scale; motion and rotation coefficients.
parameters.zh: 中心、尺度、四元数、RGB、透明度，时间中心／尺度，以及运动和旋转系数。

learn.en: Fit geometry, lifespan, motion and base color to synchronized multi-view video.
learn.zh: 用同步多视角视频拟合几何、生命周期、运动和基础色。

exported.en: The checked STG-Lite PLY schema, or our time-addressed streaming chunks.
exported.zh: 已核对的 STG-Lite PLY 字段，或本站支持时间寻址的 streaming 分块。

runtime.en: Time evaluation → GPU culling → depth sorting → indirect splat draw.
runtime.zh: 时间求值 → GPU 剔除 → 深度排序 → 间接 splat 绘制。

contract.en: Follow the model’s time normalization, quaternion evolution and opacity activation. These released fixtures cover 50 frames, not a long trained sequence.
contract.zh: 遵循模型的时间归一化、四元数演化与透明度激活。当前发布模型覆盖 50 帧，不是已训练的长序列。

asset.en: Sear Steak: 108,317 Gaussians; Flames: 332,865. Research/evaluation assets; source notices are linked in the viewer.
asset.zh: Sear Steak：108,317 个 Gaussian；Flames：332,865 个。研究／评估资产，viewer 中附来源和许可。

appearance.zh: 特征缓冲 + 逐像素 MLP

time.zh: 多项式运动 + 时间特征

summary.en: Composite features first, then decode the image. It requires a different path from STG-Lite.
summary.zh: 先合成特征，再解码图像；需要与 STG-Lite 不同的渲染路径。

parameters.en: STG motion / opacity plus base, direction and time features and a shared decoder.
parameters.zh: STG 运动／透明度参数，加基础色、方向与时间特征，以及共享解码器。

learn.en: Jointly optimize spacetime Gaussians, features and the screen-space decoder.
learn.zh: 联合优化时空 Gaussian、特征与屏幕空间解码器。

exported.en: Complete checkpoint including the MLP. Check the release variant before loading.
exported.zh: 包含 MLP 的完整 checkpoint；加载前确认发布模型的变体。

runtime.en: Evaluate time → project / sort → composite features → decode each pixel.
runtime.zh: 时间求值 → 投影／排序 → 合成特征 → 逐像素解码。

contract.en: Decoding after blending is not equivalent to decoding each splat before blending. Dropping the full model’s decoder is not a faithful Lite conversion.
contract.zh: 先混合后解码与每点先解码后混合并不等价。直接删掉完整模型的解码器不能得到等价的 Lite 模型。

asset.en: Official implementation and model/viewer links exist. This atlas does not yet provide a verified Full checkpoint in our engine.
asset.zh: 官方提供实现及模型／viewer 入口；本目录尚未在自研引擎中验证 Full checkpoint。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

appearance.zh: 按视角生成的神经属性

summary.en: Anchors and features generate local Gaussian attributes for the current view.
summary.zh: 锚点与特征为当前视角生成局部 Gaussian 属性。

parameters.en: Anchors, offsets, scales and features; color, covariance and opacity networks.
parameters.zh: 锚点、偏移、尺度与特征，以及颜色、协方差和透明度网络。

learn.en: Learn the scaffold and shared networks from images.
learn.zh: 通过图像学习锚点结构与共享网络。

exported.en: Anchor PLY plus color_mlp.pt, cov_mlp.pt, opacity_mlp.pt and configuration.

runtime.en: Cull anchors → generate view-conditioned Gaussians → rasterize.
runtime.zh: 剔除锚点 → 生成依赖视角的 Gaussian → 光栅化。

contract.en: A PLY alone is insufficient. A single baked viewpoint does not retain the original view-adaptive representation.
contract.zh: 单个 PLY 不足以还原模型。只烘焙一个视角不能保留原始的视角自适应表征。

asset.en: Official SIBR viewer and checkpoint layout are documented. A downloadable matching checkpoint is not verified here.
asset.zh: 官方有 SIBR viewer 和 checkpoint 结构说明；此处尚未验证可下载的配套 checkpoint。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

appearance.zh: 按实现定义的 Gaussian 属性

time.zh: 标准空间场景 + 学习到的形变

summary.en: A canonical set of Gaussians is deformed to the requested timestamp.
summary.zh: 将标准空间的一组 Gaussian 变形到指定时间。

parameters.en: Canonical Gaussian parameters; spatiotemporal feature planes and deformation decoder.
parameters.zh: 标准空间 Gaussian 参数、时空特征平面和形变解码器。

learn.en: Fit the canonical scene and time-conditioned deformation from video.
learn.zh: 从视频拟合标准空间场景与依赖时间的形变。

exported.en: Canonical scene + field / network, or separately baked per-timestamp 3DGS files.
exported.zh: 标准场景 + 场／网络，或单独烘焙的逐时刻 3DGS 文件。

runtime.en: Evaluate deformation at t → obtain 3D Gaussians → render using a compatible splatter.
runtime.zh: 在 t 时刻求形变 → 得到 3D Gaussian → 使用兼容的 splatter 渲染。

contract.en: Retaining the field and playing baked frames are different deployment modes. Baking trades inference for storage, sampling and delivery costs.
contract.zh: 保留形变场与播放烘焙帧是两种部署方式。烘焙用存储、时间采样和传输开销换取更少的推理。

asset.en: HUST 4DGaussians documents a viewer and export_perframe_3DGS.py. Bring a trained checkpoint; no compatible fixture is included here.
asset.zh: HUST 4DGaussians 提供 viewer 和 export_perframe_3DGS.py。需要训练好的 checkpoint；本站尚无匹配示例。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

geometry.zh: 联合空间与时间的 Gaussian primitive

summary.en: Space and time belong to the primitive itself, rather than an external deformation field.
summary.zh: 空间和时间直接属于 primitive 本身，由四维参数共同表达。

parameters.en: 4D mean / covariance parameterization, opacity and the method’s appearance coefficients.
parameters.zh: 四维均值／协方差参数化、透明度及该方法的外观系数。

learn.en: Optimize joint spacetime primitives from dynamic observations.
learn.zh: 通过动态观测优化联合时空 primitive。

exported.en: The method’s complete 4D checkpoint, with its time and appearance conventions.
exported.zh: 该方法完整的四维 checkpoint，以及时间和外观约定。

runtime.en: Condition / evaluate the 4D primitive at t → obtain spatial contributions → render.
runtime.zh: 在 t 时刻对四维 primitive 做条件化／求值 → 获得空间贡献 → 渲染。

contract.en: “4DGS” is used by several incompatible methods. Identify the paper and checkpoint schema, not just the name.
contract.zh: 多个不兼容的方法都使用“4DGS”名称。必须识别论文与 checkpoint 结构，不能只看名字。

asset.en: Fudan’s official implementation is public. An immediately usable checkpoint / web viewer is not verified here.
asset.zh: Fudan 的官方实现已公开；此处尚未确认可直接使用的 checkpoint／网页 viewer。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

appearance.zh: 每个 primitive 的局部 RGBA 纹理场

summary.en: Different positions inside one splat can contribute different colors and opacities.
summary.zh: 同一个 splat 内的不同位置可以贡献不同的颜色与透明度。

parameters.en: Gaussian attributes, global feature planes and shared local-texture decoders.
parameters.zh: Gaussian 属性、全局特征平面和共享局部纹理解码器。

learn.en: Jointly optimize the splats and neural local texture representation.
learn.zh: 联合优化 splat 与神经局部纹理表示。

exported.en: Gaussian parameters, global fields and decoders; preserve view/time dependencies.
exported.zh: Gaussian 参数、全局场与解码器，保留方向／时间依赖。

runtime.en: Generate local texture factors → find ray–Gaussian contribution point → sample RGBA → composite.
runtime.zh: 生成局部纹理因子 → 求射线／Gaussian 贡献位置 → 采样 RGBA → 合成。

contract.en: One RGB per splat cannot preserve this representation. It can augment the base Gaussian appearance rather than replace every SH term.
contract.zh: 每点一个 RGB 无法保留这种表征。它可以扩展原有 Gaussian 外观，并不必然替换全部 SH。

asset.en: Official training/rendering code is public. No ready-to-load checkpoint or interactive web player has been verified for this atlas.
asset.zh: 官方训练／渲染代码已公开。本目录尚未验证开箱即用的 checkpoint 或交互网页播放器。

support.en: Not implemented in our Rust viewer
support.zh: 尚未接入我们的 Rust viewer

title.zh: 可重光照 GS · 材质

summary.en: Store enough information to recompute appearance under a changed light.
summary.zh: 保存足够的信息，以便在更换光源后重新计算外观。

parameters.en: Geometry, normals / material attributes, learned features and any visibility / shading networks.
parameters.zh: 几何、法线／材质属性、学习特征，以及需要的可见性／着色网络。

learn.en: Recover geometry and lighting response with the method’s supervision. SSD-GS uses varying-light observations.
learn.zh: 通过方法对应的监督恢复几何和光照响应。SSD-GS 使用变化光照下的观测。

exported.en: Material and network checkpoint, not only the RGB observed during training.
exported.zh: 材质及网络 checkpoint，不能只保留训练时观测到的 RGB。

runtime.en: Current view + light → visibility / reflectance / scattering → Gaussian contributions → composite.
runtime.zh: 当前视角 + 光源 → 可见性／反射／散射 → Gaussian 贡献 → 合成。

contract.en: Different relighting papers have different contracts. A normal and a GGX shader alone do not reproduce a learned inverse-rendering model.
contract.zh: 不同重光照论文有不同的约定。仅增加法线和 GGX shader 无法复现学习到的逆渲染模型。

asset.en: SSD-GS publishes training/rendering code. Our separate material lab uses synthetic surfels with known materials; it is not an SSD-GS reconstruction.
asset.zh: SSD-GS 公开了训练／渲染代码。本站独立材质实验使用已知材质的合成面元，并非 SSD-GS 重建结果。

support.en: Synthetic PBR lab only; research checkpoint not integrated
support.zh: 仅有合成 PBR 实验；尚未接入研究 checkpoint

code.zh: 研究代码 · 需准备模型
